description: A British woman in her forties, warm low storytelling voice, received pronunciation, literary and unhurried, gentle irony, audiobook narrator of a Jane Austen novel.
text: The Meryton rooms are full to the walls and bright as day. Sir William Lucas has seen you come in; he is already on his way. Across the room, that knot of fan-wielding young ladies watches Mr Darcy as if he were a comet. He looks nowhere. The last figure ends. He bows, and does not let go of your hand quite at once.
